steps.content: [Downtown AR]

The Fifth Avenue of Eastside is one of the most prosperous business districts. From a high vantage, dense skyscrapers and the hustle and bustle are all one can see. This place once symbolized prosperity, advancement, and inclusiveness. Now, an unstoppable disaster named Gray Mirror is corrupting every corner.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Have you heard? *** got purged too!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Ha, no pretty words can save you from the power of netizens! Gray Mirror is invincible now! Time to root out all the trash!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: That traffic sheriff who used to pull me over every day is gone too. Good riddance!

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Our dorm teacher hasn't been to work for several days. Let's hope it's not revenge from the person who got their mini-cooker confiscated by her, haha.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Everyone, please cast your vote. This guy stepped on my foot on the street and didn't apologize. Shouldn't he be purged?

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Thanks to Gray Mirror, I finally don't have to see that internet celebrity on TV anymore. His face was so annoying.
The Gray Mirror votes seem to have become an open secret. Related discussions can be heard among crowds everywhere.

"I've cast XX Inferior votes today!" "I've eliminated XX people today!" ...Lives are no longer valued, and the trials have turned into a game. Every street corner is filled with people tapping on their screens hysterically.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian Girl
steps.content: Are there always so few people on the streets? ...I should be fine, right? I haven't done anything bad... Ahhh!

She has barely finished her sentence when the ruthless, spontaneous malice emerges as digitalized Mania, bursting out of the screen in her palm. In an instant, her limbs are tightly entangled in the Corruptor's tentacles. She flails her arms and legs frantically in an attempt to break free, but her desperate cries are already swallowed by the virtual void.

After a futile struggle, the increasingly empty street once again quiets down. Indifferent passersby pay no attention to anything other than their screens, unknowingly trampling over the spot where she disappeared. After all, it's nothing more than another user purged by Gray Mirror.
[Rooftop]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Oh, isn't that the girl who gave me directions the other day? What a pity!
When you arrive at the rooftop of the TV station, Bianca is sitting on its edge, leisurely overlooking the streets below.
She seems to be expecting your arrival, as she notices the footsteps but doesn't turn around.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I just knew Ashy could defeat all the evil, knock down the bad guys, and make it to me.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You've said it's only fair if the mastermind comes out and faces you under the sun openly. This is the moment!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Do I need to introduce myself again? Hello, I am <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>, the vindicator for the innocent on Gray Mirror, the journalist who digs deep into that voting app, and the source of all chaos, aka the mastermind you're looking for! Drumroll, say my name loudly!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bi-an-ca!
The strong wind on the rooftop messes up her hair, so you can't make out her expression at the moment.

options: No, you are Gray Mirror's administrator.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The so-called man-eating Gray Mirror app is just a gimmick for you. Combatting cyberbullying and defending the victims are just methods you use to pit people against each other. You also handpick and brainwash die-hard Gray Mirror fans like Simon, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You spare no effort in egging on this online frenzy all to hype up Gray Mirror and drag more people into it. You're not worried about exposing the source of contamination. Even if we could hack the dark web and confiscate all infected phones, by then Mania would have already reached tens of thousands of people through Gray Mirror.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Out of all the talking points you've fabricated, am I the most successful one? When exactly did you start using me?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hey, hold on. Our meeting wasn't that conspiratorial. I just wanted to protect you. Not just you, I keep track of everyone listed on Gray Mirror, and I know many are innocent.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You've seen that, um... Gray Mirror Space, right? All of those purged by monsters end up there. I can't change the rules, but I can draw a line to protect the truly innocent. This is a game of justice, after all. I can't let you guys be harmed, can I?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But that line only protects those you deem innocent, right? What about those you don't approve of? They're thrown into that Mania space without any protection. Is it because you can't protect everyone, or is this your way of punishing those you consider guilty?
She smiles wordlessly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did the Underground ask you to do this? To spread Mania through Gray Mirror?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: So they're called the Underground, huh? It looks like some kind of powerful secret society. But I found them, hehe! I'm excellent at my job as a journalist, after all.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You told me you barely escaped from them, and you hoped I could stop them. At that time, I believed you. I believed that we were partners in justice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even now, I still hope that wasn't a lie.
Bianca looks at you with a surprised expression, then reveals a brilliant smile.
It seems your words really please her.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Of course it wasn't a lie. How could I lie to you? You are my only partner in justice! I simply withheld a few details about the climax and ending of the hero's tale.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Now! The truth about Bianca's investigation into Gray Mirror! A thrilling adventure between life and death! Unexpected clues leading to the ultimate truth! No fees or subscriptions needed! The generous Bianca will tell you everything now!
[Try using chibi character from here]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: As you already know, the brave journalist ventured deep into enemy territory and found the suspicious server, but she got subdued by the men in black raincoats! However, the story was far from over!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: With her strong will and robust physique, the great journalist Bianca grasped something even as she was barely conscious! She opened her eyes to find in her arms a black box emitting a tempting faint light in the darkness!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Oh my god! That was Gray Mirror's administrator rights! One second the enemy seemed to have prevailed, but the next they handed everything over to the protagonist... This kind of dramatic twist only belongs in a superhero movie!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stand your ground as a truth-seeking journalist and find a chance to escape?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or make the necessary sacrifices and hold out until a "partner in justice" appears, whom you will then pass the truth onto?
steps.female_content: Or make the necessary sacrifices and hold out until a partner in justice appears, whom you will then pass the truth onto?

steps.content: Watching her joyful smile bloom, you already know the answer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You chose the third way... You accepted Gray Mirror, seeing it as a rare opportunity to cooperate with the Underground. Everything that happened afterward was exactly as you expected.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hahaha, oh, Ashy, Ashy! No one knows me better than you do!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hahahahhaha... Yes, no one ever threatened me. The monsters let go and left, leaving only a magic box waiting to be opened. They set me free. So the clever Apple Juice understood immediately.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I didn't get a chance to play the hero. What lay before Apple Juice was not a choice between life and death, but the red and blue pills, a fair multiple-choice question, an unbiased transaction, and a silent message...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: "I know why you've come, our honorable Apple Juice. You despise Gray Mirror and its atrocities. You hate all those who hide in the shadows and do evils as they please. Risking your life to come here must be your last resort, right? Well, let us show you another way."

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: "Choose the blue pill, you may be able to destroy Gray Mirror, but you'll have to keep on fighting the countless invisible enemies on Red Mirror, White Mirror, and Blue Mirror? Or choose the red pill, you'll open the magic box, release the malice within, and see how it would end for it and its owners?"

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I know you'd choose the blue pill, Ashy. Hehe, too bad I'm not you. I have neither magical powers nor strong connections. My legs go weak at the sight of monsters and I always fail in obtaining information. But there are things even I can't tolerate. So, my answer is quite obvious, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I must become the new administrator of Gray Mirror and write a scandalous story to get everyone to download the app. I must make all the evildoers suffer from Mania and let them reap what they have sown! A world where kindness is rewarded and evil is punished, that is what Bianca the justice defender dreams of!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: As long as I can rid the city of its rotten roots, I don't mind sinking into the black sludge myself! Let the brave Apple rot and be purged too! As long as Eastside remains perfect and immaculate, I don't care!
[Back to regular proportion?]

She is enraptured by her own speech, wrapping her arms around herself emotionally. Those blue eyes with vertical pupils gleam with a malevolent light. Her gaze follows the ants beneath her feet contentedly and finally reaches your face. She smiles.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You've said malice exists naturally in people's hearts and that they should learn to restrain it, that it's all Gray Mirror's fault for unleashing people's hatred and arming them with the killing knife.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But I think quite the opposite. Gray Mirror is just a tool. What has the tool done wrong? Without Gray Mirror, there will still be another battlefield. Evils will find the next outlet, and it won't be hard.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The evildoers will never restrain themselves. They want to act on their malice, which they hold above everything. To hell with empathy! To hell with guilt! They've even adorned this malice with the crown of justice so that the world can always revolve around them!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But they know too well how ugly and shady they are, so they hide their sharp teeth and claws in the shadows of Gray Mirror. They're too self-aware and smart! I can only lure them out with the most tempting bait!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ashy, you are the most delicious golden apple I've custom-made for them. The golden apple that can lure out the bad guys hiding in the shadows!

Her voice grows increasingly impassioned as she spreads her arms as if to embrace the city. Standing proudly on the edge of the rooftop, just a mere inch from falling, she seems to be declaring her victory in advance with her passionate speech.
The wind howls past her, tugging at her hair, but she doesn't care. Instead, she spreads her arms to enjoy the new chaos brought by this gust of wind, competing with it for the city's airspace.

Meanwhile, every Gray Mirror user feels a buzz from the app. Unbeknownst to them, their smartphones connected to their palms are extracting new power from them. With each tap, each vibration, the spiritual energy named malice multiplies and accumulates at the source.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Come on! All of you who wish to do evil, I offer you the knife and cover. I'll even hand you the most delectable prey. You can't refuse that, can you? Then come out and let's party together!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Expose yourselves under the sun and take a good look at your sins. It's time you receive the punishment you deserve!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I will make everyone who has ever tapped on Inferior on Gray Mirror suffer the consequences!

Vote Target: All Gray Mirror Users</color>
Nominated by user <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>.

Reason for nomination: You're an Inferior. They are an Inferior. We're all Inferiors. Come on, all of us inferior beings, let's destroy ourselves and create a perfect world!

Bianca takes out her phone and throws it into the air with full force! Strange sorcery rips the sky open to form a rift between virtuality and reality, from which numerous Corruptors emerge. The malice nurtured by the users has been further processed and put under a hideous mask by Gray Mirror, now roaring and charging into reality to commence the final Purge.
